blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – It would be impossible to source all energy and agriculture imports from the United States of America, Executive Secretary Ralph Recto said on Tuesday. US President Donald Trump recently claimed that President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. agreed to purchase 100 percent of the Philippines’ agricultural and energy imports from America starting 2027. “Palagay ko impossible naman yung 100 percent… Ang mahalaga, we are diversifying our sources of energy, sources of food,” Recto told reporters at the Senate. ‘ (I think 100 percent is impossible… The important thing is, we are diversifying our sources of energy, sources of food.)
